nodes.name: Dense Pivoted LU Linear Solver
nodes.description: Dense pivoted LU decomposition and back-solving linear system family.

nodes.name: lu_factorize_matrix
nodes.description: Compute the LU factorization of a general square matrix A.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: LU factorization of an N x N matrix requires O(N^3) floating point operations and O(N^2) space to store the factored matrix in place.

nodes.name: lu_solve_system
nodes.description: Solve a square linear system A x = b using precomputed LU factorization.
nodes.type_signature: (lu_and_piv: tuple[NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128], NDArray[np.int32]], b: NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128]) -> NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Back-solving with precomputed LU factors against a single RHS vector takes O(N^2) operations via forward/backward substitutions and O(N) auxiliary space.

nodes.name: estimate_lu_condition_number
nodes.description: Estimate the reciprocal condition number of A based on LU factors.
nodes.type_signature: (lu_and_piv: tuple[NDArray[np.float64] | NDArray[np.complex128], NDArray[np.int32]], norm_A: float) -> float
nodes.complexity_reasoning: LAPACK condition number estimation runs in O(N^2) operations given precomputed LU factors using a few backward/forward substitutions.
